blocks.text: Prefix (naam ka shuru wala hissa) side chain (alkyl group) ya kisi substituent (maslan halo, nitro jaisa functional group) ka naam deta hai, aur saath us carbon atom ka number jis se woh jura ho.

blocks.alt: Chaar shapes ki chain: peela circle 'Prefix', neela hexagon 'Stem/Root name', neela hexagon 'Primary Suffix (Suffix of Stem/root)' aur peela circle 'Secondary Suffix (Suffix of F.G.)'. Teer Prefix se 'substituent and its position on the parent chain', Stem se 'No. of carbon atoms in the parent chain', Primary Suffix se 'saturation or unsaturation in the parent chain (an, en, yn)' aur Secondary Suffix se 'family name' ki taraf jate hain.
blocks.caption: Systematic (IUPAC) naam ke hisse (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naam ko baen se daen parhein. Prefix batata hai ke branch ya substituent kaun sa hai aur chain ke kis carbon par hai (maslan 3-methyl, 4-chloro). Stem chain ke carbon ginta hai: meth 1, eth 2, prop 3, but 4, pent 5. Primary suffix batata hai ke chain saturated (an) hai ya us mein double (en) ya triple (yn) bond hai. Secondary suffix family batata hai, maslan -ol alcohol, -al aldehyde. Prefix na ho to naam sirf stem aur suffixes se banta hai, maslan butanal.
Agar prefix na ho to systematic naam sirf root aur suffix se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Do solved (hal shuda) misalein. Pehli: Cl-CH2-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-H, chain ke carbon baen se 4, 3, 2, 1 numbered, aur naam dabbe mein 4-chloro | but | an | al hisson mein, jin par prefix, stem, suffix of stem aur suffix of F.G likha hai. Doosri: CH3-C(CH3)=CH-CH2-OH, numbered 4, 3, 2, 1, naam 3- methyl | but- | 2-en- | 1-ol, unhi chaar naamon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Misalein: 4-chlorobutanal aur 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol, prefix, stem aur suffixes mein (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing; kitab ki ghalti theek ki gayi).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab pehli misal ki chain ke carbons ko 1 se 4 tak number karti hai lekin naam “4-chloro prop an al” chhaapti hai. Chain mein chaar carbon hain, is liye stem “but” hai aur sahi naam 4-chlorobutanal hai; drawing mein “but” likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Numbering hamesha us sire se shuru hoti hai jo functional group ke qareeb ho: aldehyde mein C=O wala carbon 1 hai, aur alcohol mein OH wala carbon 1. Pehli misal mein chaar carbon hain, is liye stem “but” hai; doosri mein bhi chain ke chaar carbon hain (but) aur CH₃ branch hai.
